conventions.unknown: The literal string "unknown" means no official source checked for this batch stated the value. It does not mean 'none' or 'no'.
conventions.verifiedOn: Date an official provider page was actually fetched and the record's fields were compared against it. null = not source-verified.

reviewStatus.SOURCE_VERIFIED: Official provider page fetched on verifiedOn. Existence, format, eligible audiences and an application path are confirmed there. Still requires human review before publication.
reviewStatus.NEEDS_RESEARCH: A lead only. Either the official page could not be fetched, or key facts come from third-party/search sources, or the program may be inactive.
reviewStatus.OUT_OF_SCOPE: Source-checked, but not a tech career pathway or not a program. Kept for the record and seed reconciliation.
reviewStatus.APPROVED: Human-only. Reviewed and cleared for import.

skillbridge.status.DIRECTORY_CONFIRMED: Listed in the official DoD SkillBridge directory on the check date. (None in this batch: directory unreachable.)
skillbridge.status.PROVIDER_STATED: The provider's own official page says the program is a DoD SkillBridge program/provider. Not independently confirmed.
skillbridge.status.THIRD_PARTY_ONLY: Only non-provider sources (news, job boards, base flyers) say so.
skillbridge.status.NOT_STATED: The provider's official page was checked and does not mention SkillBridge. This is NOT a claim that it isn't SkillBridge-approved.
skillbridge.status.UNKNOWN: Not checked against any provider page.
skillbridge.status.note: Secondary under the 2026-11-08 scope: recorded when seen, not researched further.

conventions.programFormat: TRAINING | CERTIFICATION_TRAINING | FELLOWSHIP | INTERNSHIP | APPRENTICESHIP | DIRECT_HIRE. A training or certification program never implies employment; see outcomeNote.
conventions.applicationStatus: ACCEPTING | ROLLING | CLOSED | UNKNOWN, as of applicationStatusAsOf. Matches the app's ApplicationAvailability enum. A program between cohorts is CLOSED; put the next opening date in applicationTiming. (Migrated 2026-11-08 from OPEN/OPEN_ROLLING/UPCOMING/NO_COHORTS_SCHEDULED.)

relatedResources.name: VA VET TEC 2.0 (High-Tech Program)
relatedResources.summary: VA benefit paying tuition/fees, monthly housing allowance and books for approved non-degree high-tech training (programming, software, data processing, information sciences, media applications). Eligibility: discharged under conditions other than dishonorable, or active duty within 180 days of separation; at least 36 months active duty; under 62 at approval. Capped at 4,000 paid participants per fiscal year. Page says you can apply online now and lists 2,273 openings as of Oct 30, 2026.
relatedResources.notes: Not a program, so it is not in `programs`. Useful as a funding attribute on programs ('accepts VET TEC 2.0'). Approved providers are on the GI Bill Comparison Tool. Third-party sources say authorization covers programs beginning before Sept 30, 2027; not stated on the VA page.
